title: Create Template
description: Creates a new ModelArmor template in a given project and location.

objective.narrative: A ModelArmor template defines a set of content filters (e.g., Responsible AI, Sensitive Data Protection) that can be applied to user prompts or model responses. This sample demonstrates creating a template with basic Responsible AI filters.
